title: More Than One
label: ch:ml-plural
canDo: I can say that there is more than one of something, and I know when to leave the ending off.

payoff.summary: From cold: the plural ending on a plain noun, the shape it takes on a noun ending in the anusvara, and the case where a number in front makes the ending unnecessary.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. No new vocabulary: every noun used is already owned, and the ending itself has been carried since the second chapter inside ningal.
